plugin.name: LAN
plugin.description: Use on both PCs when all players are on the same local network. TradeTogether discovers peers automatically by UDP broadcast. No router port forwarding or manual IP configuration is required.

plugin.name: Remote Host
plugin.description: Use on the PC hosting remote players over the Internet. Forward UDP port 27993 on the router to this PC and allow UDP 27993 through Windows Firewall. Leave PeerHost empty.

plugin.name: Remote Client
plugin.description: Use on a remote player connecting to the Skyrim Together host. TradeTogether attempts to read STR's last connected server address automatically and uses that host on UDP port 27993. PeerHost remains available as a manual fallback.
